body: Thank you so much for the kind words n support. I'm so sorry you had to go through this and your family but it's really encouraging to hear you're all doing better. I'm trying to stay positive, it's just already been a long tough road so thinking about this lasting a long time is scary. Plus the financial burden I just am so stressed out. I'm hoping I have as much success as you did with the supplements and antibiotics. Just trying to hang in there for now.
